messages:
Alex: anyone seeing a sudden rise in pending GPU pods in us-west2b?
Maya: yep, ~100+ pending since 10:05. scheduler keeps requeuing same gang jobs.
Ben: scheduler logs show Fit failure: NodeAffinity mismatch and Insufficient GPUs.
Maya: started after yesterday's provisioning rollback. reserved pool in us-west2b didn't come fully back.
Alex: also noticed eBPF rollout around 09:50 touching kube-proxy. could be conntrack causing node flaps.
Ben: kubectl describe shows nodes tainted gpu-reserved=true:NoSchedule; pods lack toleration, they had hard nodeSelector us-west2b.
Maya: some job defs used tolerationSeconds=60 which interacts with descheduler and eviction timing.
Chris: infra-bot: Auto-scaler attempted scale-up for reserved-pool-usw2b at 10:07 but failed: quotaExceeded.
Maya: so autoscaler couldn't add nodes, pendings piled up and scheduler began preempting tiny pods elsewhere to fulfill gangs.
Alex: tradeoff — relax nodeSelector/topologySpread to allow cross-AZ placement? will raise egress/cost concerns.
Sanjay: cross-AZ will hike egress costs; need finance sign-off for sustained change. :money_with_wings:
Maya: proposed immediate actions: 1) request GPU quota bump 2) change non-critical canaries to preferredDuringScheduling instead of required 3) validate/revert eBPF if implicated 4) add best-effort gang fallback.
Alex: will canary preferredDuringScheduling (weight 50). Maya open quota ticket.
Ben: after canary ~30 pods scheduled across us-west2a/c but saw more preempts in 2a due to taint propagation and overlapping preempt windows.
Maya: infra-bot created INC-2026-0042.
Chris: infra-bot: autoscaler treated 'drained' nodes as unschedulable and skipped scale-out due to precondition; that's wrong.
Maya: agreed bug — drained pool should be allowed for reprovisioning. add pool-state tag to autoscaler logic.
Alex: action items: Maya -> quota+cloud support; Alex -> roll canary; Ben -> gather scheduler traces; Infra -> revert eBPF only with clear signal; Product/Finance -> temp cross-AZ approval.
Ben: captured scheduler snippet:
E1010 10:12:34 Fit failure for pod train-large-7: NodeSelector mismatch; node had taint gpu-reserved=true:NoSchedule
E1010 10:13:42 Insufficient GPUs: requested 4, available 0 on node gke-usw2b-pool-3
Maya: monitoring canary now.
Sanjay: long-term needs: pool-provision-health metric, autoscaler precondition tweak (handle drained separately), cost-aware emergency scheduling toggle.
Ben: I'll upload traces + k8s events to incident doc.
Alex: postmortem owners: Maya (infra), Ben (scheduler), Alex (runbook).
Maya: update +20m: preempts reduced, more pods scheduled. will revert canary if stable.
Chris: infra-bot: incident INC-2026-0042 escalated to PD level 2.
Maya: drafting postmortem once stable.
